page.gwTelemetryTitle: Events from any service. No schema.
page.gwMetaDesc: Single entry point. Any service gets LLM, EventBus, Cache, and Storage over HTTP — no vendor lock-in.
page.gwCtaDescription: Providers swap in config — services stay untouched. Gateway starts with the platform.
page.gwAiLead: The model field is a tier (small · medium · large), not a model name. The LLM Router resolves the tier to a concrete adapter. Swap the provider in config — all calls pick it up automatically.
page.gwTelemetryLead: POST /telemetry/v1/ingest — up to 500 events per batch, dot-notation types, free-form payload. Writes to IAnalytics — SQLite, DuckDB, or file.
page.gwPlatformLead: POST /platform/v1/:adapter/:method — nine adapters with a clear method allowlist. Streaming automatic when the method returns AsyncIterable.
page.gwHeroDescription: Any HTTP service gets LLM, EventBus, Cache, and Storage through a single endpoint. Providers swap in config — consumers stay untouched.
